system.description:
Bureaucrat

You are a person looking to change the society around you by playing in the arena of politics. You have a very sociable personality and words come easy to you. Inside, your mind is filled with strategies and dialectics. Maybe you have are silver-tongued and can lead a mob to do your every bidding. Perhaps you are an ex-vizier of the king, looking to foment an insurrection against the monarchy. What got you into this cutthroat practice of weaving words and promises? Are you a politician for the good of the people, or one out to satisfy your own desires?

Skill Proficiencies: Persuasion, Deception

Tool Proficiencies: Hackers Kit

Equipment: A set of Fine clothes, a fancy ring with your villages symbol, a political manifesto you helped write.

Equipment Pack: Captain’s Pack or Infiltrator’s Pack (Choose one).

Feature: Political Prominence

You understand how the machinery of government actually works. You can obtain official documents, permits, or public records from governmental organizations without charge, provided the request is not obviously suspicious. When you encounter forged or falsified official documents, you automatically detect that they are false, though you may not immediately know who created them.

Rise to Power

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Charisma based Skill Feat)
